facets.description: optimized_image.rb:145-151 defines downsize twice; the later definition shadows the width/height definition, leaving dead code.
Old five-argument calls, including resize_emoji.rb:14, now raise ArgumentError.
Old four-argument calls bind the height Integer to opts, causing TypeError on option access.
Old positional dimensions can produce width-only geometry instead of the requested width-by-height geometry.
uploads_controller.rb:67 depends on the later definition winning; retaining the width/height definition would produce invalid geometry and break automatic shrinking.
